constantsNote: Place centre is the middle of the Yaba box in research/world-drive/03-real-lagos-map-pipeline.md (lat 6.49-6.53, lon 3.36-3.40). Gravity: WGS84 normal gravity (Somigliana formula) at 6.51 N, sea level. Air density: ideal gas law, p = 101325 Pa (ISO 2533 standard sea-level pressure), T = 27 °C (a rounded estimate, UNVERIFIED; see constantsSources). Ground height is not stored here; it comes from the terrain data.

constantsSources.source: WGS84 normal gravity (Somigliana formula, k = 1.931852652458e-3, e² = 6.69437999014e-3, equatorial gravity 9.7803253359 m/s²), standard NIMA TR8350.2 (2000). Constants read from the published tables at ahrs.readthedocs.io; the TR8350.2 text itself was not opened. Recomputing the formula at the place's latitude gives the stored value (tested).
constantsSources.period: Not a climate value: defining constants of the WGS84 ellipsoid (2000 edition of TR8350.2)

constantsSources.source: UNVERIFIED. No official Lagos normal (NiMet, or WMO/NOAA 1991–2020 for Lagos/Ikeja) could be opened. T = 27 °C is a rounded estimate, p = 101325 Pa is the ISO 2533 standard, so 1.176 kg/m³ is a placeholder until the real normal is read. The only 1991–2020 figure found (27.45 °C) was on a travel-weather site that does not name its station, so it is not used.
